# TUNIGHT Terrace Restro & Banquet

> Vegetarian terrace restaurant and banquet venue in Raj Nagar, Ghaziabad, opposite Gaur Central Mall.

## Key facts
- Address: J-1, Opposite Gaur Central Mall, RDC, Raj Nagar, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201002
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 78400 03009
- Food: vegetarian (tandoor, starters, momos, platters)
- Spaces: rooftop terrace dining, fine dining, Grand Banquet Hall for 100–150 guests
- Events: birthdays, farewells, small gatherings, corporate events
- Book: Zomato (https://www.zomato.com/ncr/tunight-raj-nagar-ghaziabad/book), Swiggy Dineout (https://www.swiggy.com/restaurants/noida/raj-nagar/tunight-642366/dineout), phone or WhatsApp

- Paneer Tikka: ₹299
- Malai Chaap: ₹279
- Crispy Corn: ₹229
- Tandoori Momos: ₹249
